description: Source code implementing scheme, host, and port matching rules for URL filtering in the Chromium project, including parsing and evaluation of URL components against patterns, IP addresses, CIDR blocks, and hostname patterns.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule
classes.description: Base class for URL scheme, host, and port matching rules.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule
classes.description: Rule matching URLs based on hostname patterns, optional scheme, and port.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule
classes.description: Rule matching URLs with specific IP address host and optional scheme and port.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule
classes.description: Rule matching IP address blocks (CIDR notation) with optional scheme.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::FromUntrimmedRawString
methods.description: Creates a matcher rule from a raw URL string, parsing scheme, host, port, CIDR, or IP literal.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates if a URL matches the hostname pattern, scheme, and port.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if a URL's host matches the specified IP address host pattern.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if a URL's IP address falls within the specified CIDR block.
